name: aiseo-weekly-audit
prompt: Run seo-weekly-report on the primary site stored in MEMORY.md. Produce the 3-section delta report (current snapshot / changes vs last / next actions). If MEMORY.md has no primary site, ask the user to set one and skip this run.
prompt_template: Run seo-weekly-report on {primary_site}. Produce the 3-section delta report (current snapshot / changes vs last / next actions).

_aiseo_notes.purpose: weekly delta — current vs last snapshot for the user's primary SEO-tracked site
_aiseo_notes.deliver_choice_rationale: local writes job stdout to ~/.hermes/cron/output/ — no messaging toolset involved (messaging is in agent.disabled_toolsets)
